integrity: All reported formulas have exact proof and a reproducible standard-library arithmetic checker; numerical checks are supplementary.
scientific_limitations: The result only treats residues 0 and -1 modulo odd primes and does not prove Guo Conjecture 5.2 in other residue classes. Independent priority and proof audit are not performed.
title: Sharp local valuation law for Guo’s quartic Delannoy congruence defect
